title: Third Eye: Beyond Immediate Gains in Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.12988v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Does a useful self-update remain useful after the model updates again? Third Eye separates immediate performance from the outcome of a further native update. We evaluate five 3-8B backbones on math and code: 64 fresh runs, three candidates per run, and three continuations per candidate. Selection and final scoring use disjoint items. In the balanced Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B comparison, immediate-selected utility is near zero, but continuation reduces it by 1.78 percentage points (simultaneous 95% interval [0.68, 2.88]). Candidate-averaged immediate utility is already negative: selection partly accounts for the apparently neutral first step. Continuation also lowers utility for SmolLM3-3B and Llama-3.1-8B; Qwen3-8B remains inconclusive. Target and out-of-distribution losses dominate retention changes. Matched recipe and recipient-donor controls identify neither a reliable mitigation nor a single mechanism. The results support evaluating pe

translated_title: 第三只眼：超越递归自我改进中的即时收益
translated_abstract: 一个有用的自我更新在模型再次更新之后是否仍然有用？Third Eye 将即时性能与进一步原生更新的结果分离开来。我们在数学和代码任务上评估了五个3-8B参数的基座模型：共64次全新运行，每次运行产生三个候选，每个候选进行三次后续更新，且候选选择与最终评分使用互不相交的题目。在均衡的Qwen3-4B/Llama-3.2-3B对比中，经即时选择得到的效用接近于零，但后续更新使其降低了1.78个百分点（同时95%置信区间[0.68, 2.88]）。候选平均的即时效用本身已是负值：选择机制在一定程度上解释了表面上中性的第一步。后续更新同样降低了SmolLM3-3B和Llama-3.1-8B的效用；Qwen3-8B的结果仍无定论。目标损失和分布外损失主导了保留效果的变化。匹配配方和接收者-捐赠者对照实验既未找到可靠的缓解手段，也未确定单一机制。这些结果支持对……进行评估（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文通过大规模受控实验发现，递归自我改进中看似有用的自我更新在经过第二轮更新后效用会进一步降低（甚至候选平均即时效用已为负值），因此对自我改进的评估必须超越第一步的即时收益。
